A truck is 10 seconds away - and you already saw it. What would you do if you could see exactly 10 seconds into the future?

This Short is a cut of the full video on the channel: "What If You Could See 10 Seconds Into the Future?"

What would YOU do with ten seconds? Tell me in the comments.
